summary: Bulk approve reports success for requests it silently skipped
confidence_basis: Code signal at the bug site; one account seen; no metrics of its own.

disposition_evidence.text: Bulk approve returns 200 with every id listed as approved, but three stay in Pending Review

steps.because: A customer workaround exists: approve the skipped requests one by one
No escalation applies; code signal already counted for a sibling ticket is not double counted here

workaround.text: Approve the skipped requests one at a time in the UI.
workaround.who: support, and customers can be told

repro.expected: All 10 approved, or an error naming the ones that failed
repro.actual: The response lists all 10 as approved; 3 remain in Pending Review

locations.evidence: bulk path catches the commit error per item and still adds the id to the approved list

hypothesis.statement: The bulk path catches each failed commit and still reports the item as approved.
hypothesis.confirm_by: A test that fails one commit in a bulk call gets that id reported as failed
hypothesis.refute_by: The failed id is already reported as failed

alternatives.statement: The skipped requests were locked by another reviewer and the bulk path treats a lock as success.
alternatives.confirm_by: The skipped ids were open in another session at the time
alternatives.why_less_likely: the code at :131 catches the commit error itself, before any lock check
